Who We Are
"Run beyond miles.
For the
Greater Good."

SBMRC — SBM ITB Running Club — is the official running community of the School of Business and Management, Institut Teknologi Bandung.

In 2026, we take on the ITB Ultramarathon — 180 KM from Jakarta to Bandung — to unite the SBM ITB community and raise funds for Dana Lestari ITB.

Every step we run is a statement. Every donation moves a student's future forward. Running is our vehicle. Impact is our destination.

Every Rupiah Moves Us 180 KM Forward

SBMRC runs for more than medals. A portion of every jersey sale and direct donation goes to Dana Lestari ITB — supporting students and our community.

Your support covers race entry fees, training camps, equipment, and the community events that keep us running together toward our Rp200 million goal.

Meet Our Ultramarathon Heroes

The Teams Running for Us

180 KM. Jakarta to Bandung. 7 teams. Each stride carries the weight of a community's hope and the spirit of #ForTheGreaterGood.

Elite Runners
R1 · Solo Ultra
ZENITH
Solo · 180 KM Unbroken
One runner. 180 KM. No relay, no rest. The ultimate test of human endurance from Jakarta to Bandung.
1 RunnerFull Route
R2 · 2-Person Relay
APEX
2 Runners · 90 KM Each
Two runners, one shared mission. Each covers half the route in perfect relay.
2 RunnersRelay
R4 · 4-Person Relay

4 Runners · 45 KM Each

4 RunnersRelay
R8 · 8-Person Relay
VANGUARDS
8 Runners · ~22.5 KM Each
Eight vanguards leading the charge — grit, stamina, and team spirit across every segment.
